title: Support, mass bound and weak continuity of cones
statement: For P, m ∈ ℕ there is a constant c ≥ 0 such that for every R ≥ 0: (a) if X ∈ D_m(ℝ^P), C ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P), spt X ⊆ B̄_R(0) and Cone(X, C), then spt C ⊆ B̄_R(0), and if moreover M(X) < ∞ then M(C) ≤ c·R·M(X); (b) if X_j, X ∈ D_m(ℝ^P), C_j, C ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P), spt X_j ⊆ B̄_R(0) for all j, spt X ⊆ B̄_R(0), Cone(X_j, C_j) for all j, Cone(X, C) and X_j ⇀ X, then C_j ⇀ C. Here Cone(X, C) means: C(ω) = X(ψ) whenever ω ∈ D^{m+1}(ℝ^P), ψ ∈ D^m(ℝ^P) and ψ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for all x in some open N ⊇ spt X and all v.
